description: I’m using Pro-Flex 300 to make this drywall repair along setting-type joint compound. I like to prefill the gap, embed the tape and make it as flat as possible. The wider strip of Pro-Flex with the memory-free hinge is great for this kind of project. Many thanks to ClarkDietrich for sponsoring this tutorial #drywall #drywallrepair
